pos.personaBrief: El Gráfico says the ball was the engine, reducing own-goal risk and creating danger, and Gantman shows a high short team with PPDA 7.4; the side wanted the ball and won it back fast.

pro.personaBrief: Menotti wanted precision, speed and mobility and a hard-running direct 4-3-3 with 11 recoveries under six seconds, but also quick continuous passing and building with the ball.

est.personaBrief: Menotti demanded players apply instructions to the letter and the XI had defined roles (one tapon, box-to-box 8, wide wingers), but midfielders had total freedom to create and Kempes started left and roamed.

lar.personaBrief: Bertoni and Ortiz played very wide, Ortiz beating defenders to the byline for crosses, with Luque central; the width came from wingers in a 4-3-3.

blo.personaBrief: Short team standing very high, constant pressure and achique, offside trap, PPDA 7.4, and Menotti said advancing on the opponent wins the ball highest.

mar.personaBrief: Evidence is thin: recovery came from collective occupation of spaces and an offside line, though Tarantini was more devoted to marking.

pla.personaBrief: Menotti picked technically gifted players for his idea, insisted on the same style and attacking intent even in the final, and imposed his model.

res.personaBrief: Menotti said he did not care for winning 1-0 from a free kick and held the same attacking intent in the final; style matters to him, yet he won the trophy.

sis.personaBrief: Menotti demanded collective effort through occupation of spaces and literal application of instructions, while valuing technical players inside roles.

jog.personaBrief: Menotti stressed intensity and physical preparation, chose dynamic Ardiles, and critics say power decided, yet he declared technical players the base.

bas.personaBrief: Menotti opted for experience and cut 17-year-old Maradona, building on veterans like Fillol, Passarella and Kempes; a national team has no academy.

lid.personaBrief: Menotti held firm: refused Gatti leave, cut Maradona, kept firm military-style camp, while fostering team spirit where nobody felt above others.
